sections.title: Organization vision, mission, strategy, key outcomes, and governance
sections.description: Defines enterprise direction, measurable outcomes, major initiatives, tech alignment, and core governance model.

subsections.title: Mission
subsections.llm_prompt: Summarize the organization's mission. Explain what it implies about priorities, customers, and competitive stance. Use most recent official sources.

subsections.title: Vision
subsections.llm_prompt: Summarize the organization's vision. Explain the desired future state and time horizon, with specific references to public statements.

subsections.title: Strategy
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe the current corporate strategy and key pillars. Provide concrete examples of how the strategy is being executed.

subsections.title: Key outcomes and KPIs
subsections.description: Outcomes used to measure strategy execution.
subsections.llm_prompt: Identify the key strategic outcomes and KPIs management uses to measure success. Explain why each is important and how it trends.

subsections.title: Challenges
subsections.description: Material business, operational, technology, and market challenges.
subsections.llm_prompt: Summarize the enterprise’s most material challenges impacting strategy, operations, and technology. Provide evidence and recent examples.

subsections.title: Strategic initiatives
subsections.description: Top enterprise strategic initiatives with executive and BU ownership.

columns.name: Initiative Name
columns.description: Official or commonly referenced initiative label.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: What the initiative is and why it matters.

subsections.llm_prompt: Identify the TOP 10 enterprise-level strategic initiatives. Provide a short 200–300 word summary first, then a table using the specified columns.

subsections.title: Strategic technology initiatives aligned to strategy
subsections.description: Top technology initiatives linked to business strategy.

columns.name: Technology Initiative Name
columns.description: Name of technology initiative or program.

subsections.llm_prompt: Identify the TOP 10 strategic technology initiatives that support the 1.6 initiatives. Provide a 200–300 word narrative first, then a table.

subsections.title: Statutory basis (governance)
subsections.llm_prompt: Explain statutory and regulatory foundations for corporate governance and how they shape oversight and accountability.

subsections.title: Corporate governance structure
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe corporate governance structure including Board, key committees, executive decision bodies, and how major strategic/technology initiatives are approved.

sections.title: Revenue Reporting
sections.description: Enterprise revenue segmentation, line-of-business, geographic mix, and trends.

subsections.title: Revenue by Business Segment
subsections.description: Prior fiscal year revenue by reporting segment and LOBs.

columns.name: Segment Revenue ($B)
columns.description: Segment total (use subtotal rows or repeat).

subsections.llm_prompt: Using latest public financials, provide prior fiscal year revenue by reporting segment and lines of business. Ensure correct rollups. Provide a brief narrative (200–300 words) before the table.

subsections.title: Revenue by Line of Business within each Segment
subsections.description: Granular LOB revenue rollups within segments.
subsections.llm_prompt: Provide a detailed revenue breakdown of all lines of business within each segment for the prior fiscal year, with correct rollups. Include a short narrative first.

subsections.title: Revenue by Geography
subsections.description: Prior fiscal year revenue by region and operating unit.
subsections.llm_prompt: Provide prior fiscal year revenue by geography and operating unit. Ensure totals match enterprise revenue. Include a short narrative first.

subsections.title: Revenue Growth Trends
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe revenue growth trends over the last 2–3 years and the drivers behind them.

subsections.title: Key Revenue Drivers
subsections.description: What materially drives revenue and margin.
subsections.llm_prompt: Identify key revenue drivers and explain their importance to the business model.

subsections.title: Revenue Forecasts
subsections.llm_prompt: Summarize management and analyst revenue outlook for the next 12–24 months.

sections.title: Organizational structure
sections.description: Enterprise operating model, hierarchy, and leadership profiling.

subsections.title: Top-level structure
subsections.llm_prompt: Produce a tree-style org chart showing C-Suite leader(s), their direct reports (Level 2), and Level 3 leaders. Include org/unit names, person names, and titles. Add a 200–300 word narrative summary.

subsections.title: Executive leadership and C-Suite
subsections.llm_prompt: Provide an enterprise executive org chart including C-Suite, Level 2, and Level 3 leaders. Include names and titles and a short summary first.

subsections.title: Group subsidiaries and regional organizations
subsections.llm_prompt: Provide org charts for major subsidiaries and regional organizations down to Level 3 reporting depth. Include names, titles, and org/unit names.

subsections.title: Technology and operations organization
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe technology and operations organization structure, including functional responsibilities and reporting relationships.

subsections.title: Operating capabilities
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe the enterprise’s critical operating capabilities and how they support strategy.

subsections.title: Operating principles
subsections.llm_prompt: Summarize enterprise operating principles and how they influence execution.

subsections.title: Leadership snapshots
subsections.description: Deep profiles for top enterprise leaders.
subsections.llm_prompt: Generate structured leadership profiles for the TOP 50–100 executives (C-Suite, L2, L3). Follow the provided profile schema for each leader.

sections.title: Workforce and Location

subsections.title: Global scale and composition
subsections.llm_prompt: Summarize enterprise workforce size, composition, and trends.

subsections.title: Organizational distribution
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe workforce distribution by business units and functions.

subsections.title: Workforce composition by function
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe workforce composition by function and how it supports operations.

subsections.title: Capability development and learning
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe capability development programs, learning platforms, and priorities.

subsections.title: Culture and employee engagement
subsections.llm_prompt: Describe culture and engagement approach, using recent evidence where available.

subsections.title: Workforce transformation

subsections.llm_prompt: Describe workforce transformation initiatives and skills shifts underway.

subsections.title: Global hubs

subsections.llm_prompt: List TOP 20 global hubs/locations with the specified columns. Provide a 200–300 word narrative summary first.
